name: octo-apm-ai-studio-latency
displayName: OCTO APM - AI Studio GenAI latency
description: Span-native latency for AI Studio LLM + agent spans, ordered slowest-first. Trace-scoped on octo-genai-studio so latency is owned by OCI APM (not derived from the Langfuse sync).
queryText: show (traces) TraceId, SpanName, gen_ai.agent.name as Agent, gen_ai.operation.name as Operation, ServiceName as Service, DurationMs where ServiceName = 'octo-genai-studio' and (SpanName like 'llm.invoke.%' or SpanName like 'agent.invoke.%' or SpanName like 'studio.%' or SpanName = 'vector_db.search' or SpanName = 'retrieval.embed') order by DurationMs desc

external_drilldowns.name: Langfuse
external_drilldowns.why: Per-observation latency + prompt/completion for this run.
